chunks: The first of them is the one known as Al-Shari'i.

key_terms.الشَّرِيعِيِّ: Al-Shari'i (a specific identifier for the false claimant)

ai.seo_question: Who is the first false claimant of deputyship mentioned in Tusi's list?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* identifies 'Al-Shari'i' as the inaugural figure among the false claimants of deputyship (al-Nuwwab al-Kadhibun) who were explicitly condemned by the Imams. His designation highlights the early proliferation of self-proclaimed intermediaries during the Minor and Major Ghayba, serving as a critical benchmark for distinguishing authentic authority from opportunistic impostors in Shia theological history.
